data.narrative: Engineered a complete defense-in-depth graceful degradation stack pairing explicit AbortController timeouts, an opossum CircuitBreaker with Prometheus state/fallback instrumentation and async retry-queue fallback, and transient-only exponential backoff with mandatory jitter. Proved end-to-end resilience under simulated slow and downed dependencies (201ms timeout cutoff vs 3s hang, 0ms open-circuit fallback with zero calls to the dead provider, and automatic Half-Open to Closed recovery) while articulating Little's Law pool math and business continuity trade-offs.

dimension_scores.observation: Kept all resilience primitives lightweight, in-memory, and Prometheus-instrumented so containerized instances degrade safely without exhausting heap or file descriptors.
dimension_scores.evidence: Clamped retry ceilings (max 10) and delay caps (<=30s) in apps/api/src/utils/resilience.ts to prevent runaway timer/memory leaks inside containers.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored a deterministic, automated resilience drill harness validating timeout cutoffs, breaker state transitions, zero-call open-circuit isolation, and jittered backoff behavior.
dimension_scores.evidence: Executed scripts/verify-module-06-resilience.ts passing 100% of assertions alongside clean TypeScript compilation.

dimension_scores.observation: Instrumented circuit breaker state gauges (0=closed, 1=half_open, 2=open), fallback counters, queue depth gauges, and structured lifecycle logs (dependency_timeout, retry_attempt, circuit_opened, circuit_half_open, circuit_closed).
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified Prometheus metrics circuit_breaker_state and circuit_breaker_fallbacks_total plus structured JSON logs across the full recovery cycle.

dimension_scores.observation: Demonstrated quantitative mastery of cascading failures using Little's Law (5s vs 500ms timeout pool saturation math) and strictly excluded permanent 4xx errors from retries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified 401 Unauthorized rejected on attempt 1 with 0 retries while transient ECONNRESET retried with randomized jitter.

dimension_scores.observation: Layered timeouts, jittered retries, and circuit breakers into a cohesive defense-in-depth architecture with an isolated async retry queue fallback returning HTTP 202.
dimension_scores.evidence: Implemented NotificationService with opossum CircuitBreaker serving 5 open-circuit fallbacks in 0ms without touching the dead provider.

dimension_scores.observation: Clearly documented worst-case latency budgets, Little's Law pool math, business-facing fallback semantics, and root-cause analyses of runaway retries and synchronized stampedes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Saved structured verification artifacts in progress/module_06_verify_proof.json and progress/module_06_break_diagnosis.json.

strengths: Defense-in-depth resilience layering: cleanly composes explicit timeouts, transient-only jittered retries, and opossum circuit breakers
Zero-dependency fallback isolation: open-circuit fallback enqueues notifications locally in <1ms without touching the failing provider
Defensive guardrail engineering: clamps maxRetries and enforces a mandatory jitter floor so misconfigurations cannot trigger retry storms or stampedes
data.recommendation: Translate these resilience signals (circuit_breaker_state, HighErrorRate, fallback queue depth) into clear 3 AM operational runbooks in Module 07.

public_evidence.technical_detail: AbortController timeout enforcement, finite retry clamping (0..10), jitter floor >=5ms, and circuit_breaker_state/circuit_breaker_fallbacks_total metrics
public_evidence.proof: Verified via scripts/verify-module-06-resilience.ts: 201ms timeout cutoff, 0ms open fallback, randomized jitter delays, and 0 retries on HTTP 401.
public_evidence.ability: Graceful Degradation, Circuit Breakers & Thundering-Herd Prevention
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Prevents slow downstream providers from exhausting server pools or triggering synchronized retry stampedes during recovery.

public_evidence.student_action: Built circuit-breaker-protected multi-channel NotificationService with async retry-queue fallback wired to POST /notifications/send.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Returns HTTP 200 on primary delivery and HTTP 202 with queued_fallback payload while updating notification_queue_depth gauge during degradation
public_evidence.proof: Verified full Closed -> Open -> Half-Open -> Closed recovery cycle with 0 provider calls during open state.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Preserves zero notification loss and sub-millisecond fallback latency during external provider outages.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Implemented and empirically verified opossum breaker tripping on threshold, serving isolated fallbacks, probing half-open, and closing on recovery.
Implemented bounded transient-only retry helper with randomized jitter and verified non-uniform retry delays across runs.
Replaced implicit library defaults with AbortController timeouts and quantified connection-pool saturation under 5s vs 500ms timeouts.
Designed async retry-queue fallback returning HTTP 202 without depending on the failing provider.

teaching_approaches.detail: Executed full failure-first chaos drill across slow, downed, and recovering dependencies to observe every state transition.
